mapper.insert: insert into oa_import_batch ( batch_no, file_name, file_path, template_version, total_rows, success_rows, fail_rows, update_rows, skip_rows, status, error_file_url, operator_id, operator_name, dept_id, create_time ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{templateVersion}, #{totalRows}, #{successRows}, #{failRows}, #{updateRows}, #{skipRows}, #{status}, #{errorFileUrl}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{deptId}, sysdate() )
mapper.select: select batch_id, batch_no, file_name, file_path, template_version, total_rows, success_rows, fail_rows, update_rows, skip_rows, status, error_file_url, operator_id, operator_name, dept_id, create_time, confirm_time from oa_import_batch where batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.update: update oa_import_batch set success_rows = #{successRows}, fail_rows = #{failRows}, update_rows = #{updateRows}, skip_rows = #{skipRows}, error_file_url = #{errorFileUrl} where batch_id = #{batchId}

update oa_import_batch set status = '1', success_rows = #{successRows}, fail_rows = #{failRows}, update_rows = #{updateRows}, skip_rows = #{skipRows}, error_file_url = #{errorFileUrl}, confirm_time = sysdate() where batch_id = #{batchId} and status = '0'
mapper.select: select max(batch_no) from oa_import_batch where batch_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
